name: Japanese Gardens

pitch_detail.notes: Left-facing dihedral (5.10a to first chains), continues past chains, two fingers-to-hands cruxes, finishes on finger crack.
Jam/lieback increasing in difficulty, ledgy climbing to upper-right anchor.
Flare with fingercrack, physical jamming around a roof and slab to belay.
Slab climbing through left-facing corners/arches, easing to 5.9 slabs at the top.

gear: Doubles in cams up to a #2 Camalot
Single #3 and #4 Camalot for the wide, laybacking moves on pitch 1
Small nuts for the finger-crack sections higher on the route
Bolted anchors at the top of each of the four pitches
A 70 m rope reaches the first-pitch anchor for a rappel or toprope lap; place a small cam (e.g. a #1) left of the anchor as a directional so the rope doesn't jam in the crack
fa: Lowell Anderson, Dave Page, Jim Stoddard. FFA: Terry Lien, Jon Nelson
